displayName: fmt::format C++ → Java 17 + Spring Boot + JUnit 5
description: Reference C++→Java-17 scaffold for fmt-style format APIs. Per ADR-027 this is the pure-Java rewrite (no native dependency); a JNA-fallback variant ships under archetype/jna-variant/ for cases the rewrite cannot handle (heavy template meta-programming, intrinsics). Per ADR-026 one spec per primary template — the Java projection collapses `template<typename... Args>` to a varargs `Object... args` overload. Every public surface carries @SpecClaim(...) annotations citing the signed spec's INV / OL / TI / UB / EX claim ids.

matches.fallback: Used when the routine sits inside fmt::* and exposes a format-string-plus-args API surface.
